content.title: Australian Consulate-General in
content.text: New South Wales (NSW) is perfectly positioned on Australia’s east coast, with easy access to Hong Kong and the other rapidly growing markets of the Asia-Pacific. As the largest and most diverse economy in Australia, with a highly skilled, diverse workforce, the NSW Government welcomes businesses from around the world. There are significant investment opportunities in industries such as manufacturing, agrifood, health and life sciences, clean economy, technology, and defence and aerospace. Sydney, Australia’s largest city and financial centre, is a great place to live and an excellent place to do business. With its vibrant culture, gleaming harbour and employment opportunities, it is a magnet for international talent. NSW offers significant economic opportunities, a favourable time zone for dealing with the Asia-Pacific, expansive air and sea networks, and a stable political environment. That is why NSW is the perfect place to expand your global reach. Investment NSW has 21 offices around the world including a team in Hong Kong dedicated to working with you to make the most of opportunities in NSW. For more information about how we can help you grow please contact: Trade & Investment Director - Hong Kong Shupei Chen shupei.chen@austrade.gov.au Or visit: Investment NSW NSW Government
